title: Playground Fun
text:
Tom likes the playground. It is sunny in spring, and the children play on the swings and slides. Tom plays with his friend Anna every day after school.

In autumn, the leaves on the trees are red and yellow. Anna and Tom like to jump in the leaves. In winter, the playground is cold and white with snow. They wear warm hats and gloves.

questions.text: Who does Tom play with every day?
What colors are the leaves in autumn?
Why do Tom and Anna wear warm hats and gloves?
options: Because it is cold in winter
Because it is hot in summer

questions.text: How do Tom and Anna probably feel about the playground?

vocabulary.definition: an outdoor place where children play
seats hanging from ropes that children move back and forth on
the flat green or colored parts that grow on trees
warm covers for the hands worn in cold weather

paragraph_translations: Том любить дитячий майданчик. Навесні сонячно, і діти гойдаються на гойдалках та катаються з гірок. Том грає зі своїм другом Анною щодня після школи.
Восени листя на деревах червоне і жовте. Анна і Том люблять стрибати в листі. Взимку дитячий майданчик холодний і білий від снігу. Вони носять теплі шапки та рукавички.
